summary: Special-effects teardown. Optionally logs entry via a debug-log gate, then frees every allocated array (a 60-byte-stride emitter array and two 108-byte-stride arrays, each with a count word stored 4 bytes before the pointer), cleans the collision tree nodes, and zeroes all twelve fields. Called from Game_Post when leaving the game session.

local_names.v3: running element index over this+0x14 array
local_names.result: loop bound read from this+0x10; also carries last free return value

operations.description: Debug-log gate: if StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_25, 3371) is nonzero, run the entry log write.
DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aEnteredSpecial_3) writes the 'entered special' message to the global log channel.
Zero this+0x0, the emitter count field.
If this+0x4 is non-null, the 60-byte-stride array is live and is freed.
Walk the 60-byte-stride emitter array backwards (count stored at ptr-4, element i at ptr + 60*i), calling sub_4CA280 on each element as a per-element destructor/cleanup.
FreeWrapper_7bcf(ptr-4) releases the count-header buffer of the emitter array, then this+0x4 is zeroed.
CollisionTreeNodeCleanup((int)dbl_7C9360) tears down the collision tree node pool referenced by the global.
If this+0xC is non-null, the first 108-byte-stride array is live and is freed.
Walk the 108-byte-stride array backwards (27 dwords per element), calling FreeIfNonNull on each element.
FreeWrapper_7bcf(ptr-4) releases the count-header buffer of the first 108-byte-stride array.
Before the element loop this+0x8 and this+0xC are zeroed (count fields for the 108-byte arrays).
For this+0x10 iterations, call MultiFieldFree on each 108-byte-stride element of the array whose base is this+0x14.
If this+0x14 is non-null, the second 108-byte-stride array is live and is freed.
Walk the 108-byte-stride array backwards calling sub_4CA410 on each element as a per-element destructor.
FreeWrapper_7bcf(ptr-4) releases the count-header buffer of the second 108-byte-stride array.
Zero the remaining fields this+0x14, 0x10, 0x18, 0x1C, 0x20, 0x24, 0x28, 0x2C, resetting the special-effects system to a pristine state.
Return the value carried through by the last FreeWrapper_7bcf call (result).
